title: U.S. Midterm Elections Day: Prediction Markets Price Democrats at Nearly 75% to Win Senate
summary: Prediction market traders priced Democrats at nearly 75% odds of winning Senate control ahead of Nov. 3 midterm elections, per CNBC. Election outcomes will shape U.S. fiscal and regulatory policy into 2027, with potential impact on tech, pharma, and energy sectors.
why: 中期选举结果影响美国财政政策与科技监管走向，对持仓中的美股（PLTR、TSLA、NVDA、INTC等）有潜在影响。本次run白名单信源覆盖严重不足，仅收录1条：苹果/阿里Qwen China开发者测试（11/2公告）、SNDK/MU铠侠NAND警告（11/2）、TSLA德州Robotaxi扩张（11/2-3）等重大消息均只有非白名单URL（heygotrade.com、247wallst.com、tradingkey.com），无法入库；Palantir Q3（0e65174907b2e659）与英特尔Q4展望（4deca08debf4c278）已在前序run中收录，seen.json去重命中；Pop Mart Q3披露（b1589eaf66a0bb7d）同样seen.json已有。受此限制，大盘头条实际入库仅1条。
